# Camunda 7 element-template schema

`camunda-element-template.schema.json` is vendored unchanged from
<https://unpkg.com/@camunda/element-templates-json-schema@0.22.1/resources/schema.json>.
Retrieved 2026-11-17; SHA-256:
`df9a6d3dcacc8f4e1cdf4b3cad4265c08dee39ebc63fd24304102037c2abdfd4`.

The upstream project is <https://github.com/camunda/element-templates-json-schema>.
`LICENSE-camunda` is its MIT licence, copied from
`packages/element-templates-json-schema/LICENSE` at commit
`af49d0ea911be7b37a705a491dfdcac62c19a9d4`.

The schema contains only local JSON references and is used offline by
`test_contract.py`. It validates Camunda 7 templates, not Camunda 8 templates.
